brand.name: Aston Martin
brand.tagline: British sports and grand touring car maker, founded 1913
brand.description: British maker of sports cars, grand tourers and SUVs, founded in 1913 by Lionel Martin and Robert Bamford and based in Gaydon, England. Cars are imported to India as completely built units and sold through Aston Martin New Delhi, the only Indian dealer on the brand's official dealer locator.

models.name: Vantage

items: Front mid-mounted 4.0-litre twin-turbo V8, rear-wheel drive
Rear mid-mounted ZF 8-speed automatic transaxle with electronic differential
Steel brakes 400/360 mm; carbon ceramic brakes optional
Rear subframe mounted directly to the body
Apple CarPlay (CarPlay Ultra depending on market)
360 W 11-speaker audio; 1,170 W 15-speaker Bowers & Wilkins optional
Satellite navigation with natural voice control
Lane keep assist and blind-spot assist
Rear cross-traffic assist and door exit warning
21-inch forged wheels on Michelin Pilot Sport S 5 tyres
Alcantara and leather 'Accelerate' trim with satin carbon inlays
Knurled drive-mode dial in red or silver

highlights: Sold in India as Vantage S coupe and Vantage S Roadster
4.0-litre twin-turbo V8 rated at 680 PS and 800 Nm
Claimed top speed 325 km/h; 0–100 km/h in 3.4 s (coupe)
Rear-wheel drive with ZF 8-speed automatic transaxle
Roadster has a Z-fold fabric roof

variants.name: Vantage S Roadster
features: Z-fold fabric roof, operates in 6.8 s at up to 31 mph
Same 680 PS / 800 Nm V8 as the coupe

models.notes: Price not published by the brand; from Autocar India (post-India-UK FTA price list, 1 Aug 2026; the article names no city), matched by CarDekho's Nov 2026 list (ex-showroom New Delhi). Only the S versions are priced in India; the S models replaced the standard Vantage and Vantage Roadster. India launch date of the S models not found. Roadster-specific dimensions/weight not published for the S; model-level specs are the coupe's. Torque rpm band differs between the official page (2,000–5,000) and press release (3,000–6,000). Boot not published. Engine cc taken from the official DBX S page (same 4.0 V8). Colour set is representative; India availability not confirmed.

models.name: DB12

items: ZF 8-speed automatic with shift-by-wire; shift time cut 43% to 120 ms on the S
Carbon ceramic brakes (410/360 mm) standard on the S
Wireless Apple CarPlay (CarPlay Ultra) and wired Android Auto
390 W 11-speaker audio; Bowers & Wilkins 1,170 W system available
Fixed rear spoiler and dual-element front splitter (S)

highlights: Sold in India as DB12 S coupe and DB12 S Volante convertible
4.0-litre twin-turbo V8 rated at 700 PS and 800 Nm
Carbon ceramic brakes standard on the S
Claimed top speed 325 km/h; 0–100 km/h in 3.5 s (coupe)
2+2 seating

variants.name: DB12 S Volante
features: K-fold fabric roof (opens in 14 s, works at up to 35 mph)
Boot 206 L roof up / 169 L roof down (DB12 Volante figures)
Same 700 PS / 800 Nm V8 as the coupe

models.notes: Price not published by the brand; from Autocar India (post-India-UK FTA price list, 1 Aug 2026; the article names no city), matched by CarDekho's Nov 2026 list (ex-showroom New Delhi). Only the S versions are priced in India; they replaced the standard DB12 and DB12 Volante. India launch date of the S models not found. Aston Martin publishes no separate DB12 S Volante specs; roof and boot figures quoted are from the DB12 Volante page. Coupe boot not published for the S (standard DB12: 262 L). Airbag count not published. Colour set is representative; India availability not confirmed.

models.name: DBX

items: 9-speed automatic with multi-plate wet clutch in place of a torque converter
All-wheel drive with active centre transfer case and electronic rear limited-slip differential
Air suspension with active roll control
Boot 638 L (491 L below the load shelf)

highlights: Sold in India as the DBX S, which replaced the DBX707
4.0-litre twin-turbo V8 rated at 727 PS and 900 Nm
Claimed top speed 310 km/h; 0–100 km/h in 3.3 s
All-wheel drive with 9-speed wet-clutch automatic
Boot capacity 638 litres

variants.name: DBX S
features: Active roll control (body roll limited to 1.5°)

models.notes: Price not published by the brand; from Autocar India (post-India-UK FTA price list, 1 Aug 2026; the article names no city), matched by CarDekho's Nov 2026 list (ex-showroom New Delhi). DBX707 is no longer listed for India (replaced by the DBX S); the global DBX GT has no India price and is not included. India launch date of the DBX S not found. Gearbox is a wet-clutch automatic (not a torque converter or DCT), mapped to Automatic. Fuel tank not published on the DBX S page; official kerb weight 2,245 kg (DIN) vs 2,198 kg quoted by Autocar India — check. Colour set is representative; India availability not confirmed.

models.name: Vanquish

items: Bowers & Wilkins 1,170 W 15-speaker audio as standard
Pirelli P Zero PZ4 tyres with noise-cancelling technology

highlights: Sold in India as Vanquish coupe and Vanquish Volante convertible
5.2-litre twin-turbo V12 rated at 835 PS and 1,000 Nm
Claimed top speed 345 km/h
Carbon ceramic brakes and Bowers & Wilkins audio as standard
Coupe launched in India in March 2025

variants.name: Vanquish
features: Two-door coupe with panoramic glass roof

variants.name: Vanquish Volante
features: K-fold fabric roof: opens in 14 s, closes in 16 s, works up to 50 km/h
Boot 219 L roof closed / 187 L roof stowed
Black roof standard; red, blue or black-and-grey optional

models.notes: Price not published by the brand; from Autocar India (post-India-UK FTA price list, 1 Aug 2026; the article names no city), matched by CarDekho's Nov 2026 list (ex-showroom New Delhi). The coupe launched in India on 22 Mar 2025 at ₹8.85 crore; the Volante was first priced for India in the Aug 2026 list. Seating is two as standard (2+2 reported as optional — check). Airbag count not published. Colour set is representative; India availability not confirmed.
